text:
sam: Heads-up: small eu canary of streaming runtime toggle just went out. I'm seeing reconnects + duplicate billing flashes in the console, route eu-central-1. Anyone on-call?

tala: grabbing alerts. Which rollout id?

sam: rollout=RL-412, alert ALRT-3300. logs: 
```
2026-03-23T11:12:01Z INFO route-swap from=eu-central-1 to=eu-west-2 session=z9y8x
2026-03-23T11:12:02Z WARN resume-miss session=z9y8x kv-prefix-miss
2026-03-23T11:12:03Z INFO billed tokens=39 session=z9y8x
```

rene: looks like resume failed on swap -> client retried full regen against new shard -> double-billed. sampling for reconnect traces is 0.005 which masked early signal.

tala: can we temporarily raise reconnect sampling to 0.15 for EU and add a per-route duplicate_tokens metric to the canary panel?

sam: yes. also propose a 15s sticky-preference to the previous shard for requests that immediately follow a mode flip. minimizes double regen window.

rene: agree. small billing guard would help too: dedupe by resume_id within 10s window to avoid quick double-charges. low-risk stopgap.

sre-bot: [automated] Alert ALRT-3300 acknowledged by sam. PM ticket PMT-7833 created.

tala: bumping sample_frac now and adding chart. monitoring CPU on original shard.
sam: if counts don't fall in 7m we roll back the canary.

tala: initial results: duplicate_tokens spike at T+4m, CPU on previous shard +18%. reverting if not cleared in 10m. :eyes:
